name: IdentityBench
description: IdentityBench v4.1 & v4: multi-turn Enterprise IGA & Zero-Trust agent benchmark (Connectors, NHI Classification, NP-Hard Role/SoD Math, JIT/CAE, Access Reviews, JML) with multi-agent skills & steering. Published results run on v4_lite/v41_lite (60 scenarios, 360 tasks); harness supports v4_full/v41_full (180 scenarios, 1,080 tasks).
